meta.description: Map nucleosome center positions, occupancy, and fuzziness from ATAC-seq fragment-size patterns using NucleoATAC, ATACseqQC, DANPOS3, or scprinter. Use when characterizing nucleosome organization at promoters and enhancers, calling +1/-1 nucleosomes flanking NFRs, generating V-plots for chromatin structure visualization, or comparing nucleosome positioning between conditions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; uncited quantitative claims are filed as NUCPOS-012

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics skill with no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: Methods are established (V-plot, NucleoATAC, DANPOS3); centring and strand handling defects are filed NUCPOS-004 and NUCPOS-005 and scored down

code_usability.detail: estimate_nrl.py raises IndexError on real ATAC data (NUCPOS-001) and nucleosome_analysis.R halts at the shift step and then lacks featureAlignedSignal (NUCPOS-002, NUCPOS-003); two of the three shipped scripts are not runnable as documented

functional_suitability.note: Right method families, but the estimator, R pipeline and install recipe do not run as documented and NucleoATAC calls are empty

reliability.note: Two of three scripts fail on real data, no input guards, upstream NaN defect undetected

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is short with routed references; method-reference is long but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear step order and routing; unclear which DANPOS columns, no post-run checks, scPrinter has no command

human_usability.note: Example requests and decision table help; wrong Python 3.7 guidance would mislead

security.note: No credentials, destructive operations or network calls; unchecked inputs and file paths

maintainability.note: License and provenance preserved; stale versions and unresolved process caveats

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description; workflow gate depends on a mis-centred V-plot and claims are partly uncited

inputs.label: V-plot at 300 chr1 TSS from GM12878 rep1 (vplot.py)
inputs.note: Runs and shows the NFR hotspot, but half the fragment centres are wrong and TSS strand is ignored

assertions.text: Grid shape (600,2000) and total equal an independent recount with the script definition
NFR fragments are enriched at the TSS centre versus flanks
Fragment centre equals the true fragment centre for at least 99 percent of mono read1
assertions.note: only 50.1 percent exact; median error 112 bp for the rest

assertions.text: Strand-aware orientation is applied for a TSS list containing minus-strand genes
assertions.note: strand ignored; pooled mono ratio 1.21 vs 0.46 strand-aware

assertions.text: Rendered PNG is legible with labelled axes at intended size
assertions.note: axes and NFR band legible; lobes dim on linear scale (NUCPOS-014)

inputs.label: NRL estimate from fragment sizes (estimate_nrl.py)
inputs.note: IndexError on real GM12878 data and on the planted BAM

assertions.text: estimate_nrl returns a 150-250 bp NRL on real ATAC data
Failure on a BAM without periodicity gives an actionable message
Same peak picking with a 50 bp separation recovers the independent mono mode

inputs.label: ATACseqQC pipeline (nucleosome_analysis.R) on GM12878 rep1
inputs.note: Verbatim run halts at the shift step; with two API fixes it completes but exports are unfiltered and the heatmap is uninformative on the slice

assertions.text: Verbatim script exits 0 and writes heatmap, BAMs and summary CSV
Fragment-class fractions are parsed and plausible for ATAC (NFR > mono, mono and di present)
Script with the two API fixes completes and writes all declared outputs
assertions.note: rc 0; heatmap PDF, NFR/mono BAMs, CSV; mono BAM 100 percent 180-247 bp

assertions.text: Exported BAMs honour the stated MAPQ >= 30 filter
Heatmap is interpretable
assertions.note: uniform zero-coverage colour on chr1 slice; alt-contig out-of-bound warnings

inputs.label: NucleoATAC run at TSS-flank regions (GM12878 rep1+rep2)
inputs.note: Occupancy and NFR outputs work; nucleosome calls are empty because every z-score is NaN (upstream defect)

assertions.text: nucleoatac run exits 0 and writes all output families
Occupancy is non-degenerate and within [0,1]
NFR calls lie near TSS
assertions.note: 47 NFRs, median 83 bp from a TSS

assertions.text: nucpos.bed contains called nucleosomes
Documented Python 3.7 pip install of NucleoATAC works

inputs.label: DANPOS3 differential on a planted 40 bp shift pair
inputs.note: Recovers planted shifts; column and executable guidance missing or stale

assertions.text: treat2control_dis median is near 40 bp in the shifted half
treat2control_dis median is below 10 bp in the unshifted half
Skill rule (shift >= 30 and FDR < 0.05) recovers at least half of planted positions with no false calls
The FDR and shift columns are unambiguous from the Skill text
Documented python danpos.py invocation and GitHub-only install match the tested package
assertions.note: conda danpos3 3.2.4 provides the danpos command

key_strengths: DANPOS3 differential recovered a planted 40 bp shift (90.4 percent of positions, 0 false calls in the unshifted half) using the documented flags
NucleoATAC occupancy and NFR outputs are sound on real GM12878 data (values in [0,1]; NFR calls a median 83 bp from a TSS)
Fragment-class windows (NFR < 100, mono 180-247, di 315-473) are correct and reproduced by ATACseqQC class counts
Short routed SKILL.md with a clear tool-by-goal decision table; MIT license and provenance preserved

recommendations.title: Make estimate_nrl.py run on real ATAC data
recommendations.problem: estimate_nrl.py raises IndexError on real GM12878 chr1 data and on the planted BAM.
recommendations.root_cause: find_peaks(distance=50) is 250 bp in 5 bp bins, so the NFR peak suppresses the mono peak, and the empty selection is unguarded.
recommendations.fix: Use a distance of about 10 bins, guard the empty result with a clear message, and check against an independent mono mode. (NUCPOS-001)

recommendations.title: Repair nucleosome_analysis.R for current Bioconductor
recommendations.problem: The script halts at shiftGAlignmentsList(as(gal, GAlignmentsList)) and would then fail because featureAlignedSignal moved to ChIPpeakAnno.
recommendations.root_cause: API changes in GenomicAlignments/ATACseqQC not tracked.
recommendations.fix: Use readBamFile(asMates=TRUE) for the shift input and load ChIPpeakAnno; state tested versions and add ChIPpeakAnno to the install. (NUCPOS-002, NUCPOS-003)

recommendations.title: Fix V-plot centring and strand orientation
recommendations.problem: vplot.py mis-centres about half of mono fragments and pools plus and minus TSS, which smears the V/W that the Skill uses as its go/no-go gate.
recommendations.root_cause: Centre from one mate start and no use of the BED strand column.
recommendations.fix: Use the leftmost mate start and mirror minus-strand windows; add a recount test. (NUCPOS-004, NUCPOS-005)

recommendations.title: Correct the NucleoATAC install and detect empty calls
recommendations.problem: The Python 3.7 pip recipe fails and nucpos.bed is empty because calculateCov returns NaN (uninitialised accumulator), which the Skill blames on region size or depth.
recommendations.root_cause: Install never executed; upstream extension defect not known to the Skill.
recommendations.fix: Document the working py2.7 conda install, add a nucpos non-empty check with the NaN diagnosis and a tested workaround or alternative for +1 calls. (NUCPOS-006, NUCPOS-007)

recommendations.title: Align R exports and TSS set with the stated filters
recommendations.problem: Exported BAMs contain MAPQ < 30 reads (18.7 percent of NFR) and the TSS set contradicts its comment and includes alt contigs.
recommendations.root_cause: Two loading routes; no TSS filtering.
recommendations.fix: Filter to MAPQ >= 30 once, restrict to standard-chromosome protein-coding TSS, and check the heatmap on real rows. (NUCPOS-008, NUCPOS-009)

recommendations.title: Specify the DANPOS3 columns and current install
recommendations.problem: The shift and FDR columns are unnamed (smt_diff_FDR gives zero calls; point_diff_FDR works) and the executable and install guidance is stale.
recommendations.root_cause: Rule written without mapping to output columns or the conda package.
recommendations.fix: Name treat2control_dis and point_diff_FDR with a filter command and document the danpos executable. (NUCPOS-010, NUCPOS-011)

recommendations.title: Remove stale caveats and unsupported claims
recommendations.problem: Process language about unverified versions remains, the 10 bp H2A.Z figure and the yeast +1 position are uncited or inconsistent, and small script and scPrinter gaps remain.
recommendations.root_cause: Normalization deferred version checks and claims were not sourced.
recommendations.fix: Replace caveats with tested versions, cite or drop the claims, harden vplot.py output and add or drop the scPrinter route. (NUCPOS-012, NUCPOS-013, NUCPOS-014, NUCPOS-015)
